apps.name: RagaMentor
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.37 — In the loops list, the back chip now steps up one level: from inside a subgroup it returns to that group’s parent (and names it), instead of jumping straight to the outermost level. From a top-level group it still goes to All.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.
